layers.soc_pct: SoilGrids 2.0 soc depths ['0-5cm', '5-15cm', '15-30cm'] weighted to 0-30 cm (ml_predicted, third party)
layers.sand: SoilGrids 2.0 sand depths ['0-5cm', '5-15cm', '15-30cm'] weighted to 0-30 cm (ml_predicted, third party)
layers.clay: SoilGrids 2.0 clay depths ['0-5cm', '5-15cm', '15-30cm'] weighted to 0-30 cm (ml_predicted, third party)
layers.silt: SoilGrids 2.0 silt depths ['0-5cm', '5-15cm', '15-30cm'] weighted to 0-30 cm (ml_predicted, third party)
layers.cfvo: SoilGrids 2.0 cfvo depths ['0-5cm', '5-15cm', '15-30cm'] weighted to 0-30 cm (ml_predicted, third party)
layers.cec: SoilGrids 2.0 cec depths ['0-5cm', '5-15cm', '15-30cm'] weighted to 0-30 cm (ml_predicted, third party)
layers.bd: SoilGrids 2.0 bdod depths ['0-5cm', '5-15cm', '15-30cm'] weighted to 0-30 cm (ml_predicted, third party)

layers.ece: own LightGBM (ece) on 1 km features, replicated to 250 m grid (effective resolution 1 km; ml_predicted)
layers.esp: own LightGBM (esp) on 1 km features, replicated to 250 m grid (effective resolution 1 km; ml_predicted)

climate: TerraClimate 2011-2020 monthly climatology (ppt, pet = FAO-56 PM ETo), annual rainfall series for design rainfall (33rd percentile), native ~4 km
